class Project < ApplicationRecord
  include RefreshesStatusBoard
  SOURCE_KINDS = %w[ git local discovered ].freeze
  # Commands that only start, stop or reroute existing containers, so they are
  # safe on a discovered project whose config was rebuilt without env or secrets.
  DISCOVERED_MUTATIONS = %w[ app_start app_stop app_maintenance app_live accessory_start accessory_stop accessory_restart ].freeze
  NOTIFICATION_FORMATS = %w[ generic slack discord ].freeze

  has_many :environment_variables, -> { order(:destination, :key) }, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :project_files, -> { order(:path) }, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :command_runs, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :console_sessions, dependent: :delete_all
  has_many :server_metrics, dependent: :delete_all
  has_many :hourly_metrics, dependent: :delete_all
  has_many :health_checks, dependent: :delete_all
  has_many :alerts, dependent: :delete_all

  has_secure_token :deploy_webhook_token, length: 36
  # Proves a deploy webhook call comes from CI or the git host, on top of the
  # URL's token. See DeployHooksController.
  has_secure_token :deploy_webhook_secret, length: 36, on: :create

  encrypts :ssh_private_key, :git_ssh_private_key, :git_access_token, :notification_webhook_url, :discovered_files, :deploy_webhook_secret

  normalizes :repository_url, :local_path, :branch, :config_file, with: ->(value) { value.strip.presence }

  validates :name, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :source_kind, inclusion: { in: SOURCE_KINDS }
  validates :notification_format, inclusion: { in: NOTIFICATION_FORMATS }
  validates :branch, :config_file, presence: true
  validates :repository_url, presence: true, if: :git?
  validates :repository_url, format: { with: %r{\A(https://|ssh://|[\w.-]+@[\w.-]+:)\S+\z}, message: :invalid_git_url }, allow_blank: true
  validates :local_path, presence: true, if: :local?
  validates :discovered_service, presence: true, if: :discovered?
  validates :notification_webhook_url, format: { with: %r{\Ahttps?://\S+\z} }, allow_blank: true
  validate :config_file_is_relative
  validate :local_path_inside_projects_root, if: :local?
  validate :ssh_keys_are_private_keys

  scope :ordered, -> { order(:name) }

  after_save :register_servers, if: :saved_change_to_config_snapshots?
  after_destroy_commit :remove_clone
  after_destroy_commit :ignore_discovered_service, if: :discovered?

  def git?
    source_kind == "git"
  end

  def local?
    source_kind == "local"
  end

  def discovered?
    source_kind == "discovered"
  end

  def discovered_file_map
    JSON.parse(discovered_files.presence || "{}")
  end

  def allows_command?(command)
    !discovered? || !command.mutating? || command.key.in?(DISCOVERED_MUTATIONS)
  end

  def source_description
    if git? then "#{repository_url} · #{branch}"
    elsif local? then local_path
    else I18n.t("projects.form.kind_discovered")
    end
  end

  def workspace_path
    if local?
      Pathname.new(local_path)
    else
      Rails.configuration.x.workspaces_path.join("project-#{id}")
    end
  end

  # Destination names as found in the last config sync. The base config
  # (no -d flag) is represented by nil.
  def destinations
    config_snapshots.keys.sort.map(&:presence).presence || [ nil ]
  end

  def config_for(destination)
    KamalConfigSnapshot.new(config_snapshots[destination.to_s])
  end

  def hosts
    config_snapshots.values.flat_map { |snapshot| KamalConfigSnapshot.new(snapshot).all_hosts }.uniq
  end

  def register_servers
    Server.register(hosts)
  end

  # A host can serve several destinations, e.g. staging and production on
  # the same machine.
  def destinations_for_host(host)
    destinations.select { |destination| config_for(destination).all_hosts.include?(host) }
  end

  def destination_for_host(host)
    destinations_for_host(host).first
  end

  # Variables for the base config apply everywhere; destination-specific ones
  # override them.
  def environment_for(destination)
    variables = environment_variables.to_a
    base = variables.select { |variable| variable.destination.nil? }
    scoped = variables.select { |variable| destination.present? && variable.destination == destination }
    variables = (base + scoped).to_h { |variable| [ variable.key, variable.value.to_s ] }

    # A discovered project has no git checkout to take the version from.
    version = discovered? && discovered_versions[destination.to_s]
    version ? variables.reverse_merge("VERSION" => version) : variables
  end

  # Projects without their own key use the instance key from Settings.
  def ssh_keys
    [ ssh_private_key.presence || Setting.instance.ssh_private_key, git_ssh_private_key ].compact_blank
  end

  # Latest monitoring sample per host, which tells whether SSH works.
  def latest_metrics
    hosts.filter_map { |host| server_metrics.where(host: host).order(collected_at: :desc).first }
  end

  # Mutating commands on a protected destination need its name typed to run
  # from the browser. The base config is stored as "".
  def protected_destination?(destination)
    protected_destinations.include?(destination.to_s)
  end

  # Form checkboxes send "." for the base config, since "" is what an empty
  # selection sends.
  def protected_destinations=(names)
    super(Array(names).compact_blank.map { |name| name == "." ? "" : name.to_s }.uniq)
  end

  def confirmation_word(destination)
    destination.presence || name
  end

  def active_operation
    command_runs.active.find(&:mutating?)
  end

  def last_deploy(destination = :any)
    runs = command_runs.where(kind: %w[ deploy redeploy rollback setup ]).where.not(status: %w[ queued running ])
    runs = runs.where(destination: destination) unless destination == :any
    runs.order(created_at: :desc).first
  end

  LiveRelease = Data.define(:version, :created_at)

  # The version running for a destination, from the containers in the latest
  # monitoring samples, so apps deployed outside Kamal Web show up too.
  def live_release(destination, metrics = latest_metrics)
    config = config_for(destination)
    prefix = [ config.service, config.primary_role, destination.presence ].compact.join("-") + "-"
    container = metrics.reject(&:error).flat_map(&:containers).select do |container|
      labels = container["Labels"] || {}
      container["State"] == "running" && labels["service"] == config.service && labels["role"] == config.primary_role &&
        labels["destination"].to_s == destination.to_s && container["Names"].to_s.start_with?(prefix)
    end.max_by { |container| container["CreatedAt"].to_s }

    if container
      LiveRelease.new(version: container["Names"].delete_prefix(prefix), created_at: (Time.zone.parse(container["CreatedAt"].to_s) rescue nil))
    elsif discovered? && (version = discovered_versions[destination.to_s])
      LiveRelease.new(version: version, created_at: nil)
    end
  end

  private
    # Only clones made by Kamal Web are removed; mounted folders are left alone.
    def ignore_discovered_service
      Setting.instance.ignore_service!(discovered_service)
    end

    def remove_clone
      root = Rails.configuration.x.workspaces_path.expand_path
      FileUtils.rm_rf(root.join("project-#{id}")) unless local?
    end

    def config_file_is_relative
      if config_file.present? && (config_file.start_with?("/") || config_file.split("/").include?(".."))
        errors.add(:config_file, :not_relative)
      end
    end

    def local_path_inside_projects_root
      return if local_path.blank?

      root = Rails.configuration.x.projects_path.expand_path.to_s
      path = File.expand_path(local_path)
      unless path == root || path.start_with?("#{root}/")
        errors.add(:local_path, :outside_root, root: root)
      end
    end

    def ssh_keys_are_private_keys
      { ssh_private_key: ssh_private_key, git_ssh_private_key: git_ssh_private_key }.each do |attribute, key|
        next if key.blank?
        errors.add(attribute, :not_private_key) unless key.include?("PRIVATE KEY-----")
      end
    end
end
# A machine Kamal Web knows about. Hosts in a project's Kamal config are
# registered automatically on every sync; others can be added by hand before
# anything is deployed to them. The config stays the source of truth for
# deploys: this is only the inventory, with SSH overrides for checks.
class Server < ApplicationRecord
  CHECK_SCRIPT = "uname -srm; docker --version 2>/dev/null || sudo -n docker --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'Docker not installed'".freeze

  normalizes :host, :name, :ssh_user, with: ->(value) { value.strip.presence }

  validates :host, presence: true, uniqueness: { case_sensitive: false }, format: { with: /\A[\w.:\[\]-]+\z/ }
  validates :ssh_port, numericality: { only_integer: true, in: 1..65_535 }, allow_nil: true
  validate :host_unchanged_while_in_use, on: :update

  scope :ordered, -> { order(Arel.sql("LOWER(COALESCE(name, host))")) }

  def self.register(hosts)
    hosts.each { |host| find_or_create_by!(host: host) }
  end

  def label
    name.presence || host
  end

  def projects
    Project.ordered.select { |project| project.hosts.include?(host) }
  end

  def in_use?
    projects.any?
  end

  # The SSH user and port come from the first project deploying here, unless
  # the server overrides them.
  def effective_ssh_user
    ssh_user.presence || config&.ssh_user || "root"
  end

  def effective_ssh_port
    ssh_port || config&.ssh_port || 22
  end

  def ssh_keys
    [ Setting.instance.ssh_private_key, *projects.map(&:ssh_private_key) ].compact_blank.uniq
  end

  # Latest monitoring sample per project deploying here.
  def latest_metrics
    ServerMetric.where(id: ServerMetric.recent.where(host: host).group(:project_id).select("MAX(id)")).includes(:project).to_a
  end

  # The most recent thing known about SSH access: a manual check or a
  # monitoring sample.
  def connection
    sample = ServerMetric.where(host: host).order(collected_at: :desc).first
    if sample && (checked_at.nil? || sample.collected_at > checked_at)
      Connection.new(ok: sample.error.nil?, error: sample.error, at: sample.collected_at)
    elsif checked_at
      Connection.new(ok: check_error.nil?, error: check_error, at: checked_at)
    end
  end

  Connection = Data.define(:ok, :error, :at)

  def trusted_host_keys
    SshHostKeys.trusted(host, effective_ssh_port)
  end

  def scan_host_keys
    SshHostKeys.scan(host, effective_ssh_port)
  end

  def trust_host_key!(fingerprint)
    SshHostKeys.trust!(host, effective_ssh_port, fingerprint)
  end

  def forget_host_keys!
    SshHostKeys.forget!(host, effective_ssh_port)
  end

  def check!
    output = RemoteShell.for_server(self).run(CHECK_SCRIPT)
    update!(checked_at: Time.current, check_error: nil, system_info: output.lines.map(&:strip).compact_blank.join(" · ").truncate(255))
  rescue RemoteShell::Error => error
    update!(checked_at: Time.current, check_error: error.message)
  end

  private
    def config
      project = projects.first
      project&.config_for(project.destination_for_host(host))
    end

    def host_unchanged_while_in_use
      errors.add(:host, :in_use) if host_changed? && Server.find(id).in_use?
    end
end

Uses # the SSH user and port from the project's Kamal config, or a server's own. class RemoteShell class Error < StandardError; end TIMEOUT = 10 def self.for_server(server) allocate.tap { |shell| shell.send(:connect_as, server.host, user: server.effective_ssh_user, port: server.effective_ssh_port, keys: server.ssh_keys) } end def initialize(project, host, destination: nil) config = project.config_for(destination.to_s).presence || project.config_for(project.destinations.first) connect_as(host, user: config.ssh_user, port: config.ssh_port, keys: project.ssh_keys) end def run(command) Net::SSH.start(@host, @user, **options) do |ssh| output = +"" channel = ssh.open_channel do |ch| ch.exec(command) do |_, success| raise Error, "Could not run command on #{@host}" unless success ch.on_data { |_, data| output << data } ch.on_extended_data { |_, _, data| output << data } end end channel.wait output end rescue Net::SSH::Exception, SystemCallError, SocketError, Timeout::Error, OpenSSL::PKey::PKeyError, ArgumentError => error # Some Net::SSH errors carry only their class name, e.g. ConnectionTimeout. message = error.message == error.class.name ? "#{error.class.name.demodulize.underscore.humanize.downcase} (SSH port #{@port})" : error.message raise Error, "#{@host}: #{message}" end private def connect_as(host, user:, port:, keys:) @host, @user, @port, @keys = host, user, port, keys end def options { port: @port, key_data: @keys, keys: [], keys_only: @keys.any?, non_interactive: true, timeout: TIMEOUT, verify_host_key: SshHostKeys.net_ssh_verify, user_known_hosts_file: SshHostKeys.known_hosts, logger: Logger.new(File::NULL) } end end class ServersController < ApplicationController before_action :set_server, only: %i[ show edit update destroy check trust_host_key forget_host_key ] def index @servers = Server.ordered @projects = Project.ordered.to_a @latest_metrics = ServerMetric.where(id: ServerMetric.recent.group(:project_id, :host).select("MAX(id)")).group_by(&:host) end def show @projects = @server.projects @metrics = @server.latest_metrics @host_keys = @server.trusted_host_keys @scanned_host_keys = @server.scan_host_keys if params[:scan] && @host_keys.empty? end def new @server = Server.new end def create @server = Server.new(server_params) if @server.save @server.check! if Setting.instance.ssh_private_key.present? redirect_to @server, notice: t("flash.saved", name: @server.label) else render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity end end def edit end def update if @server.update(server_params) redirect_to @server, notice: t("flash.saved", name: @server.label) else render :edit, status: :unprocessable_entity end end # Servers in a project's config would be registered again on the next sync. def destroy if @server.in_use? redirect_to @server, alert: t("flash.servers.in_use") else @server.destroy! redirect_to servers_path, notice: t("flash.deleted", name: @server.label), status: :see_other end end def check @server.check! if @server.check_error redirect_to @server, alert: t("flash.servers.check_failed", error: @server.check_error) else redirect_to @server, notice: t("flash.servers.check_succeeded") end end def trust_host_key if @server.trust_host_key!(params[:fingerprint]) redirect_to @server, notice: t("flash.servers.host_key_trusted") else redirect_to server_path(@server, scan: 1), alert: t("flash.servers.host_key_changed") end end def forget_host_key @server.forget_host_keys! redirect_to @server, notice: t("flash.servers.host_key_forgotten"), status: :see_other end private def set_server @server = Server.find(params[:id]) end def server_params params.expect(server: [ :host, :name, :ssh_user, :ssh_port, :notes ]) end end <% content_for :title, t("common.servers") %> <%= render Ui::PageHeaderComponent.new(title: t("common.servers"), description: t(".description")) do %> <%= link_to new_server_path, class: "btn btn-primary" do %><%= render Ui::IconComponent.new(name: :plus, size: 16) %><%= t(".add") %><% end %> <% end %> <% if @servers.empty? lastPrompt: Quiero que agreguemos debajo de "Servidores" y encima de "usuarios" un panel de "Bases de datos". Y podamos attachear bases de datos en la misma maquina (o remotas por ssh) a aplicaciones existentes.…

aiTitle: Tarea programada de commit, push y deploy

content.text: Antes de construirlo necesito cerrar unas decisiones que cambian bastante el diseño:

questions.question: ¿Qué debe poder hacer Kamal Web con las bases de datos en tus servidores?

options.label: Crear y registrar (Recomendado)
options.description: Como Hatchbox: Kamal Web levanta el contenedor del motor (por SSH, en la red 'kamal', con volumen y contraseña generada) y también permite registrar uno que ya exista.

options.label: Solo registrar existentes
options.description: Tú levantas el servidor de BD (accessory de Kamal, instalado a mano...) y Kamal Web solo guarda la conexión y crea bases/usuarios dentro.

questions.question: ¿Qué motores soportamos en la primera versión?

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: DATABASE_URL postgres://

options.label: MySQL / MariaDB
options.description: DATABASE_URL mysql2://

options.label: Redis / Valkey
options.description: REDIS_URL redis://

questions.question: Al attachear una BD a una app, ¿qué hace Kamal Web?

options.label: Crea BD + usuario y fija la variable (Recomendado)
options.description: Crea una base y un usuario propios para la app (en managed: usa la URL que pegues), guarda DATABASE_URL como variable cifrada del proyecto/destino y te ofrece redeploy. La app debe tener DATABASE_URL en env.secret; el check del overview avisará si falta.

options.label: Solo fija la variable
options.description: Guarda la URL de conexión como variable del proyecto, sin crear bases ni usuarios.

questions.question: Si la BD está en otra máquina distinta a la de la app, ¿cómo llega la app a ella?

options.label: Puerto publicado con IPs permitidas (Recomendado)
options.description: El contenedor publica el puerto y Kamal Web sólo lo abre a las IPs de los servidores de las apps attacheadas (regla de firewall con iptables DOCKER-USER). Con TLS en Postgres/MySQL.

options.label: Red privada
options.description: Asumes una red privada (VPC de DigitalOcean, Tailscale...) y Kamal Web publica el puerto sólo en la IP privada que indiques.

options.label: Solo misma máquina
options.description: Las BDs creadas por Kamal Web sólo se attachean a apps en el mismo servidor; las remotas se tratan como 'managed' (URL).

<% content_for :title, "#{t("common.settings")} · #{@project.name}" %> <%= render "projects/header", project: @project %>
<%= render Ui::PanelComponent.new do %>

<%= t("common.project") %>

<%= link_to t("common.edit"), edit_project_path(@project), class: "btn btn-sm" %>
<%= t(".source") %>
<%= @project.git? ? t(".source_git", url: @project.repository_url, branch: @project.branch) : @project.local? ? t(".source_local", path: @project.local_path) : t(".source_discovered", service: @project.discovered_service) %>
<%= t(".config_file") %>
<%= @project.config_file %>
<%= t(".ssh_key") %>
<%= @project.ssh_private_key.present? ? t(".stored") : t(".not_set") %>
<%= t(".protected") %>
<%= @project.protected_destinations.map { |name| destination_label(name) }.to_sentence.presence || t(".off") %>
<%= t(".notifications") %>
<%= @project.notification_webhook_url.present? ? t("projects.form.formats.#{@project.notification_format}", default: @project.notification_format.capitalize) : t(".off") %>
<% end %> <%= render Ui::PanelComponent.new do %>

<%= t(".variables") %>

<%= t(".variables_hint_html") %>

<%= link_to t(".add_variable"), new_project_environment_variable_path(@project), class: "btn btn-sm" %>
<% if @project.environment_variables.empty? %>

<%= t(".no_variables") %>

<% else %>
<% @project.environment_variables.each do |variable| %> <% end %>
<%= t(".name") %><%= t("common.destination") %><%= t(".value") %>
<%= variable.key %> <%= variable.destination || t(".all") %> ••••••••
<%= link_to t("common.edit"), edit_project_environment_variable_path(@project, variable), class: "btn btn-sm" %> <%= button_to t("common.delete"), project_environment_variable_path(@project, variable), method: :delete, class: "btn btn-sm btn-danger", form: { data: { turbo_confirm: t(".confirm_delete", name: variable.key) } } %>

# The checklist on a project's overview: what Kamal needs to work, from what
# Kamal Web already knows (the last config sync and the latest monitoring
# samples), so it costs no SSH round trip.
class ProjectChecks
  Check = Data.define(:label, :status, :detail) do
    def ok? = status == :ok
    def failed? = status == :failed
  end

  # ENV entries a .kamal/secrets file may use without them being stored in Kamal Web.
  PROVIDED = %w[ HOME PATH USER PWD KAMAL_DESTINATION KAMAL_VERSION ].freeze

  def initialize(project, destination, latest_metrics)
    @project = project
    @destination = destination
    @config = project.config_for(destination)
    @metrics = latest_metrics
  end

  def all

    def certificate(check)
      days = check.certificate_days_left
      t("certificate", count: days) if days
    end

    def secrets_check
      return if @project.discovered?

      files = [ ".kamal/secrets-common", ".kamal/secrets", (".kamal/secrets.#{@destination}" if @destination.present?) ].compact
        .map { |file| @project.workspace_path.join(file) }.select(&:file?)
      return Check.new(t("secrets"), :ok, t("secrets_none")) if files.empty?

      defined = @project.environment_for(@destination).keys + PROVIDED
      wanted = files.flat_map { |file| file.read.lines.reject { |line| line.lstrip.start_with?("#") }.flat_map { |line| line.scan(/\$\{?([A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*)/).flatten } }.uniq
      missing = wanted - defined
      if missing.any?
        Check.new(t("secrets"), :failed, t("secrets_missing", count: missing.size, names: missing.join(", ")))
      else
        Check.new(t("secrets"), :ok, t("secrets_ok"))
      end
    end

    def repository_check
      return unless @project.discovered?

# Read-only view over the JSON produced by script/kamal_config_dump.rb.
class KamalConfigSnapshot
  attr_reader :data

  def initialize(data)
    @data = data || {}
  end

  def present?
    data.present? && error.blank?
  end

  def error
    data["error"]
  end

  def service
    data["service"]
  end

  def image
    data["image"]
  end

  def roles
    data.fetch("roles", {})
  end

  def accessories
    data.fetch("accessories", {})
  end

  def proxy_hosts
    data.fetch("proxy_hosts", [])
  end

  # Snapshots taken before these were recorded assume Kamal's defaults.
  def proxy_ssl?
    data.fetch("proxy_ssl", true) != false
  end

  def healthcheck_path
    data["healthcheck_path"].presence || "/up"
  end

  # What CheckAppHealthJob requests: each domain at the health check path.
  def health_check_urls
    proxy_hosts.reject { |host| host.include?("*") }.map { |host| "#{proxy_ssl? ? "https" : "http"}://#{host}#{healthcheck_path}" }
  end

  def ssh
    data.fetch("ssh", {})
  end

  def ssh_user
    ssh["user"].presence || "root"
  end

  def ssh_port
    (ssh["port"].presence || 22).to_i
  end

  def builder
    data.fetch("builder", {})
  end

  def primary_host
    data["primary_host"]
  end

  # Snapshots taken before primary_role was recorded fall back to Kamal's default.
  def primary_role
    data["primary_role"].presence || (roles.key?("web") ? "web" : roles.keys.first)
  end

  def all_hosts
    (roles.values.flatten + accessories.values.flatten).uniq
  end

  def raw_config

require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe "Breadcrumb navigation" do
  let(:project) { create(:project) }

  before { sign_in }

  def breadcrumb_items
    Nokogiri::HTML(response.body).css('nav[aria-label="Breadcrumbs"] li')
  end

  it "links back to the dashboard and project from a project view" do
    get project_monitoring_path(project)

    expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
    items = breadcrumb_items
    expect(items.map { |item| item.text.delete("/").strip }).to eq([ "Dashboard", project.name, "Monitoring" ])
    expect(items[0].at_css("a")["href"]).to eq(root_path)
    expect(items[1].at_css("a")["href"]).to eq(project_path(project))
    expect(items.last.at_css('[aria-current="page"]').text).to eq("Monitoring")
    expect(items.last.at_css("a")).to be_nil
  end

  it "keeps the activity list in the path to command output" do
    run = project.command_runs.create!(kind: "version")
    get project_command_run_path(project, run)

    expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
    links = breadcrumb_items.css("a")
    expect(links.map { |link| link["href"] }).to eq([ root_path, project_path(project), project_command_runs_path(project) ])
    expect(breadcrumb_items.last.at_css('[aria-current="page"]').text).to eq(run.command.label)
  end

  it "shows the parent for settings without repeating a trail on the dashboard" do
    get edit_settings_path
    expect(breadcrumb_items.first.at_css("a")["href"]).to eq(root_path)
    expect(breadcrumb_items.last.at_css('[aria-current="page"]').text).to eq("Settings")

    get root_path
    expect(breadcrumb_items).to be_empty

require "rubygems/package"
require "zlib"

# A backup of everything that can't be recreated: the main database (projects,
# encrypted secrets, history) and the secret_key_base that decrypts it. Clones,
# caches and queues are left out.
#
# Restoring stages the archive as storage/restore.tar.gz; script/apply_restore.rb
# swaps the files in when the container next boots, before the database opens.
module InstanceBackup
  # The message is a key under flash.backups.invalid.
  class Invalid < StandardError; end

  APP = "kamal-web".freeze
  ENTRIES = %w[ manifest.json database.sqlite3 secret_key_base ].freeze
  MAX_SIZE = 500.megabytes
  STAGED_PATH = Rails.root.join("storage", "restore.tar.gz")
  # Scheduled backups, when turned on in Settings.
  DIRECTORY = Rails.root.join("storage", "backups")
  STORED_NAME = /\Akamal-web-backup-\d{8}-\d{6}\.tar\.gz\z/

  module_function

  def filename
    "kamal-web-backup-#{Time.current.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")}.tar.gz"
  end

  def write(io)
    Dir.mktmpdir("kamal-web-backup") do |dir|
      database = File.join(dir, "database.sqlite3")
      # VACUUM INTO writes a consistent copy while the app keeps running.
      ActiveRecord::Base.connection.execute("VACUUM INTO #{ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote(database)}")
      manifest = { app: APP, version: KamalWeb::VERSION, created_at: Time.current.iso8601 }.to_json

      gzip = Zlib::GzipWriter.new(io)
      Gem::Package::TarWriter.new(gzip) do |tar|
        add(tar, "manifest.json", manifest)
        add(tar, "database.sqlite3", File.binread(database))
        add(tar, "secret_key_base", Rails.application.secret_key_base)
      end
      gzip.finish
    end
    io
  end

  # Writes a backup into the volume and deletes the oldest beyond keep.
  def store!(keep:)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(DIRECTORY, mode: 0o700)
    path = DIRECTORY.join(filename)
    partial = DIRECTORY.join(".#{path.basename}.partial")
    File.open(partial, "wb", 0o600) { |file| write(file) }
    File.rename(partial, path)
    stored.drop(keep).each(&:delete)
    path
  end

  # Newest first.
  def stored
    return [] unless DIRECTORY.directory?

p='app/services/remote_shell.rb'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""  def run(command)
    Net::SSH.start(@host, @user, **options) do |ssh|
      output = +""
      channel = ssh.open_channel do |ch|
        ch.exec(command) do |_, success|
          raise Error, "Could not run command on #{@host}" unless success
          ch.on_data { |_, data| output << data }
          ch.on_extended_data { |_, _, data| output << data }
        end
      end
      channel.wait
      output
    end""","""  # input is sent on stdin, which keeps passwords out of the server's
  # process list. With check, a non-zero exit status raises Error.
  def run(command, input: nil, check: false)
    Net::SSH.start(@host, @user, **options) do |ssh|
      output = +""
      status = nil
      channel = ssh.open_channel do |ch|
        ch.exec(command) do |_, success|
          raise Error, "Could not run command on #{@host}" unless success
          ch.on_data { |_, data| output << data }
          ch.on_extended_data { |_, _, data| output << data }
          ch.on_request("exit-status") { |_, data| status = data.read_long }
          if input
            ch.send_data(input)
            ch.eof!
          end
        end
      end
      channel.wait
      raise Error, "#{@host}: #{output.strip.presence || "exit status #{status}"}" if check && status != 0
      output
    end""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

  validates :engine, inclusion: { in: ENGINES }

  validates :server, presence: true, unless: :external?

  validates :container_name, uniqueness: { scope: :server_id }, allow_nil: true
  validates :image, inclusion: { in: ->(database) { IMAGES.fetch(database.engine, []) } }, if: :created?
  validates :admin_user, format: { with: /\A\w+\z/ }, allow_nil: true
  validates :public_port, numericality: { only_integer: true, in: 1024..65_535 }, allow_nil: true
  validates :url, presence: true, if: :external?
  validate :url_matches_engine, if: -> { external? && url.present? }

  after_update_commit :refresh_attachments, if: -> { saved_change_to_public_port? || saved_change_to_url? || saved_change_to_password? }
  broadcasts_refreshes

  SOURCES.each { |name| define_method(:"#{name}?") { source == name } }

    update!(status: "failed", status_message: error.message, checked_at: Time.current)
  end

  def remote_app_hosts
    attachments.includes(:project).flat_map(&:app_hosts).uniq - [ server&.host ]
  end

    manager.remove(delete_data: delete_data) if created?
    destroy!
  end

    def set_defaults
      self.container_name ||= "kamal-web-db-#{name}" if created?
      self.admin_user ||= "postgres" if postgresql? && !external?
      self.password ||= SecureRandom.hex(24) if created?
      self.status = "external" if external?
    end

    def url_matches_engine
      scheme = URI.parse(url).scheme
      errors.add(:url, :wrong_scheme, schemes: URL_SCHEMES.fetch(engine, []).join(", ")) unless scheme.in?(URL_SCHEMES.fetch(engine, []))
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError
      errors.add(:url, :invalid)
    end

    def refresh_attachments
      attachments.each(&:write_variable!)
    end
end

# Gives a project (or one of its destinations) a database: its own database
# and user on a PostgreSQL server, a database number on a Redis server, or
# the URL of an external one. The URL is stored as one of the project's
# environment variables, which .kamal/secrets passes to the app on deploy.
class DatabaseAttachment < ApplicationRecord
  REDIS_DATABASES = 16

  belongs_to :database
  belongs_to :project
  belongs_to :environment_variable, optional: true

  encrypts :password

  normalizes :destination, with: ->(value) { value.presence }
  normalizes :variable, with: ->(value) { value.strip.upcase.presence }

  validates :variable, presence: true, format: { with: /\A[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*\z/, message: :invalid_name }
  validates :variable, uniqueness: { scope: [ :project_id, :destination ] }
  validates :database_name, uniqueness: { scope: :database_id }, allow_nil: true
  validate :destination_configured
  validate :variable_free, on: :create
  validate :reachable, on: :create
  validate :redis_database_free, on: :create

  before_validation :set_credentials, on: :create

  # Creates what the app needs on the database server and stores the URL.
  def attach!
    transaction do
      save!
      database.manager.create_user(self) if database.postgresql? && !database.external?
      write_variable!
    end
    database.manager.apply_firewall if database.created? && database.public_port
    true
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid
    false
  end

  # With delete_data the app's database and user are dropped. Otherwise they
  # stay, but the user can no longer sign in.
  def detach!(delete_data: false)
    transaction do
      environment_variable&.destroy!
      destroy!
      database.manager.remove_user(self, delete_data: delete_data) if database.postgresql? && !database.external?
    end
    database.manager.apply_firewall if database.created? && database.public_port
  end

  def write_variable!
    variable_record = environment_variable || project.environment_variables.new(key: variable, destination: destination)
    variable_record.update!(value: url)
    update_column(:environment_variable_id, variable_record.id) unless environment_variable_id == variable_record.id
  end

  # The hosts the app's containers run on.
  def app_hosts
    destinations = destination ? [ destination ] : project.destinations
    destinations.flat_map { |name| project.config_for(name).roles.values.flatten }.uniq
  end

  def remote?
    database.address_for(app_hosts)&.first == database.server&.host
  end

  def url
    return database.url if database.external?

    host, port = database.address_for(app_hosts)
    if database.postgresql?
      query = "?sslmode=require" if database.tls? && remote?
      "postgres://#{username}:#{password}@#{host}:#{port}/#{database_name}#{query}"
    else
      credentials = ":#{CGI.escape(database.shared_password)}@" if database.shared_password.present?
      "redis://#{credentials}#{host}:#{port}/#{redis_index}"
    end
  end

  # Kamal only passes variables listed under env.secret to the app.
  def listed_in_config?
    destinations = destination ? [ destination ] : project.destinations
    destinations.all? do |name|
      raw = project.config_for(name).raw_config || {}
      envs = [ raw["env"], *raw.fetch("servers", {}).then { |servers| servers.is_a?(Hash) ? servers.values : [] }.map { |role| role["env"] if role.is_a?(Hash) } ]
      envs.compact.any? { |env| env.is_a?(Hash) && Array(env["secret"]).any? { |name| name.to_s.split(":").first == variable } }
    end
  end

  private
    def set_credentials
      return unless database

      if database.postgresql? && !database.external?
        self.database_name ||= [ project&.name, destination, (variable unless variable == "DATABASE_URL") ].compact.join("_").downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9]+/, "_").gsub(/\A_+|_+\z/, "").first(63)
        self.username ||= database_name
        self.password ||= SecureRandom.hex(24)
      elsif database.redis? && !database.external?
        used = database.attachments.pluck(:redis_index)
        self.redis_index ||= (0...REDIS_DATABASES).find { |index| !used.include?(index) }
      end
    end

    def destination_configured
      errors.add(:destination, :unknown) if destination && project && !project.destinations.include?(destination)
    end

    def variable_free
      return unless project && variable

      if project.environment_variables.exists?(key: variable, destination: destination)
        errors.add(:variable, :taken_by_variable)
      end
    end

    def reachable
      return if database.nil? || project.nil? || database.external?

      errors.add(:base, :not_reachable, port: database.internal_port) unless database.address_for(app_hosts)
      errors.add(:base, :not_running) unless database.status == "running"
    end

    def redis_database_free
      errors.add(:base, :no_redis_database) if database&.redis? && !database.external? && redis_index.nil?
    end
end

require "shellwords"

# Runs a database's container on its server and manages what lives in it,
# over SSH with the server's access. Docker and iptables run through sudo
# when the SSH user isn't root.
class DatabaseManager
  class Error < StandardError; end

  PRELUDE = <<~SH.freeze
    set -e
    if [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then S=; else S="sudo -n"; fi
    if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then D=docker; else D="$S docker"; fi
  SH

  CERTIFICATE_PATH = "/etc/kamal-web".freeze
  # The uid both the postgres and redis/valkey images run as.
  IMAGE_UID = 999

  def initialize(database)
    @database = database
  end

  def provision
    run(<<~SH)
      dir="#{@database.files_directory}"
      mkdir -p "$dir" && chmod 700 "$dir"
      umask 077
      #{write_files}
      $S chown #{IMAGE_UID}:#{IMAGE_UID} #{mounted_files.keys.map { |name| %("$dir/#{name}") }.join(" ")}
      $D network create kamal >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      $D pull -q #{q @database.image} >/dev/null
      $D rm -f #{q container} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      $D run --detach --name #{q container} --network kamal --restart unless-stopped \\
        --label kamal-web.database=#{q @database.name} --log-opt max-size=10m \\
        --volume #{q @database.volume_name}:#{data_path} \\
        #{mounted_files.keys.map { |name| %(--volume "$dir/#{name}:#{CERTIFICATE_PATH}/#{name}:ro") }.join(" ")} \\
        #{"--publish 0.0.0.0:#{@database.public_port}:#{@database.internal_port}" if @database.public_port} \\
        #{q @database.image} #{command} >/dev/null
      for i in $(seq 60); do
        if #{ready_check}; then exit 0; fi
        sleep 1
      done
      $D logs --tail 20 #{q container} 2>&1
      echo "The database didn't start within a minute."
      exit 1
    SH
  end

  # running, stopped or missing for containers; reachable or unreachable for
  # external databases, from a TCP connection.
  def status
    return external_status if @database.external?

    output = run(<<~SH).strip
      state=$($D inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' #{q container} 2>/dev/null) || { echo missing; exit 0; }
      if [ "$state" = running ] && #{ready_check}; then echo running; else echo "${state:-stopped}" | sed 's/^exited$/stopped/'; fi
    SH
    output.lines.last.to_s.strip.then { |state| state == "running" || state == "missing" ? state : "stopped" }
  end

  def create_user(attachment)
    psql(<<~SQL)
      DO $$BEGIN
        IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = '#{attachment.username}') THEN
          ALTER ROLE "#{attachment.username}" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '#{attachment.password}';
        ELSE
          CREATE ROLE "#{attachment.username}" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '#{attachment.password}';
        END IF;
      END$$;
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE "#{attachment.database_name}" OWNER "#{attachment.username}"' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '#{attachment.database_name}')\\gexec
    SQL
  end

  def remove_user(attachment, delete_data: false)
    if delete_data
      psql(<<~SQL)
        DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "#{attachment.database_name}" WITH (FORCE);
        DROP ROLE IF EXISTS "#{attachment.username}";
      SQL
    else
      psql(<<~SQL)
        DO $$BEGIN
          IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = '#{attachment.username}') THEN
            ALTER ROLE "#{attachment.username}" WITH NOLOGIN;
          END IF;
        END$$;
        SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename = '#{attachment.username}';
      SQL
    end
  end

  # Only the hosts of attached apps on other servers (and containers on the
  # kamal network) reach the published port. Docker's DOCKER-USER chain sees
  # the packets before they are forwarded to the container. The rules don't
  # survive a reboot, so CheckDatabasesJob applies them again.
  def apply_firewall
    accepted = @database.remote_app_hosts.map { |host| "$S iptables -A #{chain} -s #{q host} -j RETURN" }
    run(<<~SH)
      $S iptables -N #{chain} 2>/dev/null || $S iptables -F #{chain}
      subnet=$($D network inspect kamal -f '{{range .IPAM.Config}}{{.Subnet}} {{end}}' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
      [ -n "$subnet" ] && $S iptables -A #{chain} -s "$subnet" -j RETURN
      #{accepted.join("\n")}
      $S iptables -A #{chain} -j DROP
      #{firewall_rule("-C")} 2>/dev/null || #{firewall_rule("-I")}
    SH
  end

  def remove(delete_data: false)
    run(<<~SH)
      $D rm -f #{q container} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      #{"$D volume rm #{q @database.volume_name} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" if delete_data}
      rm -rf "#{@database.files_directory}"
      while #{firewall_rule("-D")} 2>/dev/null; do :; done
      $S iptables -F #{chain} 2>/dev/null || true
      $S iptables -X #{chain} 2>/dev/null || true
    SH
  end

  private
    def run(script, input: nil)
      shell = RemoteShell.for_server(@database.server)
      if input
        shell.run(PRELUDE + script, input: input, check: true)
      else
        shell.run(PRELUDE + script, check: true)
      end
    end

    def psql(sql)
      command = "$D exec -i #{q container} psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U #{q @database.admin_user} -d postgres"
      run(command, input: sql)
    end

    def external_status
      uri = URI.parse(@database.url)
      Socket.tcp(uri.host, uri.port || @database.internal_port, connect_timeout: 5).close
      "reachable"
    rescue SystemCallError, SocketError, IOError, URI::InvalidURIError
      "unreachable"
    end

    def container
      @database.container_name
    end

    def chain
      "KAMAL-WEB-DB-#{@database.id}"
    end

    def firewall_rule(action)
      "$S iptables #{action} DOCKER-USER -p tcp -m conntrack --ctorigdstport #{@database.public_port.to_i} --ctdir ORIGINAL -j #{chain}"
    end

    def q(value)
      Shellwords.escape(value.to_s)
    end

    def data_path
      if @database.postgresql?
        # PostgreSQL 18 images keep their data one level up, by major version.
        @database.image.split(":").last.to_i >= 18 ? "/var/lib/postgresql" : "/var/lib/postgresql/data"
      else
        "/data"
      end
    end

    # Written to the server with umask 077, from base64 so the content never
    # needs quoting.
    def mounted_files
      @mounted_files ||=
        if @database.postgresql?
          key, certificate = self.class.certificate(@database.container_name)
          { "postgres.env" => "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=REDACTED, "server.key" => key, "server.crt" => certificate }
        else
          { "redis.conf" => "requirepass #{@database.password}\nappendonly yes\n" }
        end
    end

    def write_files
      mounted_files.map { |name, content| %(echo #{Base64.strict_encode64(content)} | base64 -d > "$dir/#{name}") }.join("\n")
    end

    def command
      if @database.postgresql?
        "-c ssl=on -c ssl_cert_file=#{CERTIFICATE_PATH}/server.crt -c ssl_key_file=#{CERTIFICATE_PATH}/server.key"
      else
        "#{server_binary} #{CERTIFICATE_PATH}/redis.conf"
      end
    end

    def server_binary
      @database.image.start_with?("valkey") ? "valkey-server" : "redis-server"
    end

    def ready_check
      if @database.postgresql?
        "$D exec #{q container} pg_isready -q -h 127.0.0.1 -U #{q @database.admin_user} >/dev/null 2>&1"
      else
        cli = @database.image.to_s.start_with?("valkey") ? "valkey-cli" : "redis-cli"
        "$D exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH #{q container} #{cli} ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG"
      end
    end

    class << self
      # A self-signed certificate: apps use sslmode=require, which encrypts
      # without verifying it.
      def certificate(name)
        key = OpenSSL::PKey::EC.generate("prime256v1")
        certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new
        certificate.version = 2
        certificate.serial = SecureRandom.random_number(2**64)
        certificate.subject = certificate.issuer = OpenSSL::X509::Name.parse("/CN=#{name}")
        certificate.public_key = key
        certificate.not_before = Time.current
        certificate.not_after = 10.years.from_now
        certificate.sign(key, OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new)
        [ key.to_pem, certificate.to_pem ]
      end
    end
end

require "shellwords"

# Runs a database's container on its server and manages what lives in it,
# over SSH with the server's access. Docker and iptables run through sudo
# when the SSH user isn't root.
class DatabaseManager
  class Error < StandardError; end

  PRELUDE = <<~SH.freeze
    set -e
    if [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ]; then S=; else S="sudo -n"; fi
    if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then D=docker; else D="$S docker"; fi
  SH

  CERTIFICATE_PATH = "/etc/kamal-web".freeze
  # The uid both the postgres and redis/valkey images run as.
  IMAGE_UID = 999

  def initialize(database)
    @database = database
  end

  def provision
    run(<<~SH)
      dir="#{@database.files_directory}"
      mkdir -p "$dir" && chmod 700 "$dir"
      umask 077
      #{write_files}
      $S chown #{IMAGE_UID}:#{IMAGE_UID} #{mounted_files.keys.map { |name| %("$dir/#{name}") }.join(" ")}
      $D network create kamal >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      $D pull -q #{q @database.image} >/dev/null
      $D rm -f #{q container} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      $D run --detach --name #{q container} --network kamal --restart unless-stopped \\
        --label kamal-web.database=#{q @database.name} --log-opt max-size=10m \\
        --volume #{q @database.volume_name}:#{data_path} \\
        #{mounted_files.keys.map { |name| %(--volume "$dir/#{name}:#{CERTIFICATE_PATH}/#{name}:ro") }.join(" ")} \\
        #{"--publish 0.0.0.0:#{@database.public_port}:#{@database.internal_port}" if @database.public_port} \\
        #{q @database.image} #{command} >/dev/null
      for i in $(seq 60); do
        if #{ready_check}; then exit 0; fi
        sleep 1
      done
      $D logs --tail 20 #{q container} 2>&1
      echo "The database didn't start within a minute."
      exit 1
    SH
  end

  # running, stopped or missing for containers; reachable or unreachable for
  # external databases, from a TCP connection.
  def status
    return external_status if @database.external?

    output = run(<<~SH).strip
      state=$($D inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' #{q container} 2>/dev/null) || { echo missing; exit 0; }
      if [ "$state" = running ] && #{ready_check}; then echo running; else echo "${state:-stopped}" | sed 's/^exited$/stopped/'; fi
    SH
    output.lines.last.to_s.strip.then { |state| state == "running" || state == "missing" ? state : "stopped" }
  end

  def create_user(attachment)
    psql(<<~SQL)
      DO $$BEGIN
        IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = '#{attachment.username}') THEN
          ALTER ROLE "#{attachment.username}" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '#{attachment.password}';
        ELSE
          CREATE ROLE "#{attachment.username}" WITH LOGIN PASSWORD '#{attachment.password}';
        END IF;
      END$$;
      SELECT 'CREATE DATABASE "#{attachment.database_name}" OWNER "#{attachment.username}"' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '#{attachment.database_name}')\\gexec
    SQL
  end

  def remove_user(attachment, delete_data: false)
    if delete_data
      psql(<<~SQL)
        DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "#{attachment.database_name}" WITH (FORCE);
        DROP ROLE IF EXISTS "#{attachment.username}";
      SQL
    else
      psql(<<~SQL)
        DO $$BEGIN
          IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = '#{attachment.username}') THEN
            ALTER ROLE "#{attachment.username}" WITH NOLOGIN;
          END IF;
        END$$;
        SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename = '#{attachment.username}';
      SQL
    end
  end

  # Only the hosts of attached apps on other servers (and containers on the
  # kamal network) reach the published port. Docker's DOCKER-USER chain sees
  # the packets before they are forwarded to the container. The rules don't
  # survive a reboot, so CheckDatabasesJob applies them again.
  def apply_firewall
    accepted = @database.remote_app_hosts.map { |host| "$S iptables -A #{chain} -s #{q host} -j RETURN" }
    run(<<~SH)
      $S iptables -N #{chain} 2>/dev/null || $S iptables -F #{chain}
      subnet=$($D network inspect kamal -f '{{range .IPAM.Config}}{{.Subnet}} {{end}}' 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
      [ -n "$subnet" ] && $S iptables -A #{chain} -s "$subnet" -j RETURN
      #{accepted.join("\n")}
      $S iptables -A #{chain} -j DROP
      #{firewall_rule("-C")} 2>/dev/null || #{firewall_rule("-I")}
    SH
  end

  def remove(delete_data: false)
    run(<<~SH)
      $D rm -f #{q container} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
      #{"$D volume rm #{q @database.volume_name} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" if delete_data}
      rm -rf "#{@database.files_directory}"
      while #{firewall_rule("-D")} 2>/dev/null; do :; done
      $S iptables -F #{chain} 2>/dev/null || true
      $S iptables -X #{chain} 2>/dev/null || true
    SH
  end

  private
    def run(script, input: nil)
      shell = RemoteShell.for_server(@database.server)
      if input
        shell.run(PRELUDE + script, input: input, check: true)
      else
        shell.run(PRELUDE + script, check: true)
      end
    end

    def psql(sql)
      command = "$D exec -i #{q container} psql -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U #{q @database.admin_user} -d postgres"
      run(command, input: sql)
    end

    def external_status
      uri = URI.parse(@database.url)
      Socket.tcp(uri.host, uri.port || @database.internal_port, connect_timeout: 5).close
      "reachable"
    rescue SystemCallError, SocketError, IOError, URI::InvalidURIError
      "unreachable"
    end

    def container
      @database.container_name
    end

    def chain
      "KAMAL-WEB-DB-#{@database.id}"
    end

    def firewall_rule(action)
      "$S iptables #{action} DOCKER-USER -p tcp -m conntrack --ctorigdstport #{@database.public_port.to_i} --ctdir ORIGINAL -j #{chain}"
    end

    def q(value)
      Shellwords.escape(value.to_s)
    end

    def data_path
      if @database.postgresql?
        # PostgreSQL 18 images keep their data one level up, by major version.
        @database.image.split(":").last.to_i >= 18 ? "/var/lib/postgresql" : "/var/lib/postgresql/data"
      else
        "/data"
      end
    end

    # Written to the server with umask 077, from base64 so the content never
    # needs quoting.
    def mounted_files
      @mounted_files ||=
        if @database.postgresql?
          key, certificate = self.class.certificate(@database.container_name)
          { "postgres.env" => "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=REDACTED, "server.key" => key, "server.crt" => certificate }
        else
          { "redis.conf" => "requirepass #{@database.password}\nappendonly yes\n" }
        end
    end

    def write_files
      mounted_files.map { |name, content| %(echo #{Base64.strict_encode64(content)} | base64 -d > "$dir/#{name}") }.join("\n")
    end

    def command
      if @database.postgresql?
        "-c ssl=on -c ssl_cert_file=#{CERTIFICATE_PATH}/server.crt -c ssl_key_file=#{CERTIFICATE_PATH}/server.key"
      else
        "#{server_binary} #{CERTIFICATE_PATH}/redis.conf"
      end
    end

    def server_binary
      @database.image.start_with?("valkey") ? "valkey-server" : "redis-server"
    end

    def ready_check
      if @database.postgresql?
        "$D exec #{q container} pg_isready -q -h 127.0.0.1 -U #{q @database.admin_user} >/dev/null 2>&1"
      else
        cli = @database.image.to_s.start_with?("valkey") ? "valkey-cli" : "redis-cli"
        "$D exec -e REDISCLI_AUTH #{q container} #{cli} ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG"
      end
    end

    class << self
      # A self-signed certificate: apps use sslmode=require, which encrypts
      # without verifying it.
      def certificate(name)
        key = OpenSSL::PKey::EC.generate("prime256v1")
        certificate = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new
        certificate.version = 2
        certificate.serial = SecureRandom.random_number(2**64)
        certificate.subject = certificate.issuer = OpenSSL::X509::Name.parse("/CN=#{name}")
        certificate.public_key = key
        certificate.not_before = Time.current
        certificate.not_after = 10.years.from_now
        certificate.sign(key, OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new)
        [ key.to_pem, certificate.to_pem ]
      end
    end
end

  def index
    @databases = Database.ordered.includes(:server, attachments: :project)
  end

  def show
    @attachments = @database.attachments.includes(:project).order(:created_at)
    @projects = Project.ordered.to_a
  end

  def new
    source = params[:source].presence_in(Database::SOURCES) || "created"
    engine = params[:engine].presence_in(Database::ENGINES) || "postgresql"
    @database = Database.new(source: source, engine: engine, image: Database::IMAGES[engine].first)
  end

  def create
    @database = Database.new(database_params)

    if @database.save
      if @database.created?
        @database.update!(status: "provisioning")
        ProvisionDatabaseJob.perform_later(@database)
      else
        @database.check!
      end
      redirect_to @database, notice: t("flash.saved", name: @database.name)
    else
      render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def edit
  end

  def update
    attributes = database_params.except(:engine, :source, :server_id, :image)
    attributes.delete(:password) if attributes[:password].blank?
    attributes.delete(:url) if attributes[:url].blank?

    if @database.update(attributes)
      # Publishing another port means running the container again.
      if @database.created? && @database.saved_change_to_public_port?
        @database.update!(status: "provisioning")
        ProvisionDatabaseJob.perform_later(@database)
      end
      redirect_to @database, notice: t("flash.saved", name: @database.name)
    else
      render :edit, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def destroy
    if @database.attachments.any?
      redirect_to @database, alert: t("flash.databases.in_use")
    else
      @database.remove!(delete_data: params[:delete_data] == "1")
      redirect_to databases_path, notice: t("flash.deleted", name: @database.name), status: :see_other
    end
  rescue RemoteShell::Error => error
    redirect_to @database, alert: t("flash.databases.failed", error: error.message)
  end

  def check
    @database.check!
    if @database.status == "failed"
      redirect_to @database, alert: t("flash.databases.failed", error: @database.status_message)
    else
      redirect_to @database, notice: t("flash.databases.checked", status: t("databases.statuses.#{@database.status}"))
    end
  end

  private
    def set_database
      @database = Database.find(params[:id])
    end

    def database_params
      params.expect(database: [ :name, :engine, :source, :server_id, :image, :container_name, :admin_user, :password, :url, :public_port ])
    end
end

input.command:
cat > app/views/databases/show.html.erb <<'EOF' <% content_for :title, @database.name %> <%= turbo_stream_from @database %> <%= render Ui::PageHeaderComponent.new(title: @database.name, description: t("databases.engines.#{@database.engine}")) do %> <% unless @database.status == "provisioning" %> <%= button_to check_database_path(@database), class: "btn btn-quiet" do %><%= render Ui::IconComponent.new(name: :refresh, size: 15) %><%= t(".check") %><% end %> <% end %> <%= link_to t("common.edit"), edit_database_path(@database), class: "btn" %> <% end %>
<%= render Ui::PanelComponent.new do %>

<%= t(".details") %>

<%= render "databases/status", database: @database %>
<%= t(".source") %>
<%= t("databases.sources.#{@database.source}") %>
<% if @database.external? %>
<%= t(".host") %>
<%= URI.parse(@database.url).then { |uri| [ uri.host, uri.port ].compact.join(":") } rescue "–" %>
<% else %>
<%= t(".server") %>
<%= link_to @database.server.label, server_path(@database.server), class: "hover:underline" %>
<%= t(".container") %>
<%= @database.container_name %>
<% if @database.image %>
<%= t(".image") %>
<%= @database.image %>
<% end %>
<%= t(".same_server") %>
<%= @database.container_name %>:<%= @database.internal_port %>
<%= t(".other_servers") %>
<%= @database.public_port ? tag.span("#{@database.server.host}:#{@database.public_port}", class: "font-mono") : t(".not_published") %>
<% end %>
<%= t(".last_check") %>
<%= @database.checked_at ? time_ago(@database.checked_at) : t("servers.show.never_checked") %>
<% if @database.status == "provisioning" %>

<%= t(".provisioning") %>

<% elsif @database.status_message.present? %> 
<%= @database.status_message.last(1500) %>
<% end %> <% if @database.created? && @database.public_port %>

<%= t(".firewall_hint") %>

<% elsif @database.existing? && @database.public_port %>

<%= t(".firewall_existing_hint") %>

<% end %> <% end %> <%= render Ui::PanelComponent.new do %>

<%= t(".attachments") %>

<%= t(".attachments_hint_#{@database.engine}#{"_external" if @database.external?}") %>

<% if @attachments.empty? %>

<%= t(".no_attachments") %>

<% else %>
<% @attachments.each do |attachment| %> <% end %>
<%= t("common.project") %><%= t("common.destination") %><%= t(".variable") %>
<%= link_to attachment.project.name, project_path(attachment.project), class: "font-medium text-foreground hover:underline" %> <% if attachment.database_name %>

<%= attachment.database_name %>

<% elsif attachment.redis_index %>

/<%= attachment.redis_index %>

<% end %> 		<%= attachment.destination || t("projects.settings.show.all") %> <%= attachment.variable %> <% if attachment.remote? %>

<%= t(".remote") %>

<% end %> <% unless attachment.listed_in_config? %>

<%= t(".not_in_config_html", variable: tag.code(attachment.variable), line: tag.code("#{attachment.variable}=$#{attachment.variable}")) %>

<% end %>
<%= button_to t(".detach"), database_attachment_path(@database, attachment), method: :delete, class: "btn btn-sm", form: { data: { turbo_confirm: t(".confirm_detach_#{@database.postgresql? && !@database.external? ? "postgresql" : "other"}", project: attachment.project.name, variable: attachment.variable) } } %> <% if @database.postgresql? && !@database.external? %> <%= button_to t(".detach_delete"), database_attachment_path(@database, attachment), method: :delete, params: { delete_data: "1" }, class: "btn btn-sm btn-danger", form: { data: { turbo_confirm: t(".confirm_detach_delete", database: attachment.database_name) } } %> <% end %>
<% end %> <% if @projects.any? %> <%= form_with model: DatabaseAttachment.new, url: database_attachments_path(@database), class: "border-t border-line px-4 py-4 flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3" do |form| %>
<%= form.label :target, t(".app"), class: "label" %> <%= form.select :target, @projects.map { |project| [ project.name, [ [ "#{project.name} · #{t("projects.settings.show.all")}", "#{project.id}/" ], *project.destinations.compact.map { |destination| [ "#{project.name} · #{destination}", "#{project.id}/#{destination}" ] } ] ] }, {}, class: "input", grouped: true %>
<%= form.label :variable, t(".variable"), class: "label" %> <%= form.text_field :variable, value: @database.default_variable, class: "input font-mono", autocomplete: "off" %>
<%= form.submit t(".attach"), class: "btn btn-primary" %> <% end %> <% else %>

<%= t(".no_projects") %>

<% end %> <% end %> <%= render Ui::PanelComponent.new(class: "border-danger/30") do %>

<%= t("projects.settings.show.danger_zone") %>

<% if @attachments.any? %>

<%= t(".delete_in_use") %>

<% elsif @database.created? %>

<%= t(".delete_created_hint", volume: @database.volume_name) %>

<%= button_to t(".delete_keep"), database_path(@database), method: :delete, class: "btn btn-danger", form: { data: { turbo_confirm: t(".confirm_delete", name: @database.name) } } %> <%= button_to t(".delete_data"), database_path(@database), method: :delete, params: { delete_data: "1" }, class: "btn btn-danger", form: { data: { turbo_confirm: t(".confirm_delete_data", name: @database.name, volume: @database.volume_name) } } %>
<% else %>

<%= t(".delete_registered_hint") %>

<%= button_to t("common.delete"), database_path(@database), method: :delete, class: "btn btn-danger", form: { data: { turbo_confirm: t(".confirm_delete", name: @database.name) } } %>
<% end %>
<% end %>

require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe Database do
  let(:server) { Server.create!(host: "192.0.2.10") }

  it "names a created container and generates its password" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17")

    expect(database).to have_attributes(container_name: "kamal-web-db-main", admin_user: "postgres", volume_name: "kamal-web-db-main")
    expect(database.password).to match(/\A\h{48}\z/)
    expect(Database.new(name: "Main DB", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17")).not_to be_valid
    expect(Database.new(name: "other", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "mysql:8")).not_to be_valid
  end

  it "checks the scheme of an external URL" do
    expect(Database.new(name: "managed", engine: "postgresql", source: "external", url: "redis://example.com")).not_to be_valid
    expect(Database.create!(name: "managed", engine: "postgresql", source: "external", url: "REDACTED").status).to eq("external")
  end

  describe "attachments" do
    let(:database) { Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17", status: "running") }
    let(:manager) { instance_double(DatabaseManager, create_user: "", remove_user: "", apply_firewall: "") }

    before { allow(DatabaseManager).to receive(:new).and_return(manager) }

    it "gives an app on the same server its own database over the kamal network" do
      project = create(:project, name: "shop")
      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL")

      expect(attachment.attach!).to be(true)
      expect(manager).to have_received(:create_user).with(attachment)
      expect(attachment).to have_attributes(database_name: "shop", username: "shop")
      expect(project.environment_for(nil)["DATABASE_URL"]).to eq("postgres://shop:#{attachment.password}@kamal-web-db-main:5432/shop")
      expect(manager).not_to have_received(:apply_firewall)
    end

    it "needs a published port for an app on another server, then connects over TLS" do
      project = create(:project, name: "shop", config_snapshots: { "production" => { "roles" => { "web" => [ "192.0.2.20" ] } } })
      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, destination: "production", variable: "DATABASE_URL")

      expect(attachment.attach!).to be(false)
      expect(attachment.errors[:base].first).to include("port for other servers")

      database.update!(public_port: 25432)
      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, destination: "production", variable: "DATABASE_URL")
      expect(attachment.attach!).to be(true)
      expect(attachment.database_name).to eq("shop_production")
      expect(project.environment_for("production")["DATABASE_URL"]).to end_with("@192.0.2.10:25432/shop_production?sslmode=require")
      expect(database.remote_app_hosts).to eq([ "192.0.2.20" ])
      expect(manager).to have_received(:apply_firewall)
    end

    it "updates the stored URL when the database changes and removes it on detach" do
      project = create(:project, name: "shop", config_snapshots: { "" => { "roles" => { "web" => [ "192.0.2.20" ] } } })
      database.update!(public_port: 25432)
      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL")
      attachment.attach!

      database.update!(public_port: 25433)
      expect(project.environment_for(nil)["DATABASE_URL"]).to include("192.0.2.10:25433")

      attachment.reload.detach!
      expect(manager).to have_received(:remove_user).with(attachment, delete_data: false)
      expect(project.environment_variables.reload).to be_empty
    end

    it "doesn't replace a variable the project already has" do
      project = create(:project)
      project.environment_variables.create!(key: "DATABASE_URL", value: "sqlite3:storage/production.sqlite3")

      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL")
      expect(attachment.attach!).to be(false)
      expect(attachment.errors[:variable]).to be_present
    end

    it "tells whether the app's config passes the variable on" do
      project = create(:project, config_snapshots: { "" => { "roles" => { "web" => [ "192.0.2.10" ] }, "raw" => { "env" => { "secret" => [ "RAILS_MASTER_KEY", "DATABASE_URL" ] } } } })
      expect(database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL")).to be_listed_in_config
      expect(database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "QUEUE_DATABASE_URL")).not_to be_listed_in_config
    end

    it "gives each Redis app its own database number" do
      redis = Database.create!(name: "cache", engine: "redis", source: "created", server: server, image: "valkey/valkey:8", status: "running")
      first, second = create(:project, name: "a"), create(:project, name: "b")

      redis.attachments.new(project: first, variable: "REDIS_URL").attach!
      redis.attachments.new(project: second, variable: "REDIS_URL").attach!

      expect(first.environment_for(nil)["REDIS_URL"]).to eq("redis://:#{redis.password}@kamal-web-db-cache:6379/0")
      expect(second.environment_for(nil)["REDIS_URL"]).to end_with("/1")
      expect(manager).not_to have_received(:create_user)
    end

    it "passes an external URL on as it is" do
      managed = Database.create!(name: "managed", engine: "postgresql", source: "external", url: "REDACTED")
      project = create(:project)

      expect(managed.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL").attach!).to be(true)
      expect(project.environment_for(nil)["DATABASE_URL"]).to eq(managed.url)
      expect(manager).not_to have_received(:create_user)
    end
  end
end
EOF

require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe Database do
  let(:server) { Server.create!(host: "192.0.2.10") }

  it "names a created container and generates its password" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17")

    expect(database).to have_attributes(container_name: "kamal-web-db-main", admin_user: "postgres", volume_name: "kamal-web-db-main")
    expect(database.password).to match(/\A\h{48}\z/)
    expect(Database.new(name: "Main DB", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17")).not_to be_valid
    expect(Database.new(name: "other", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "mysql:8")).not_to be_valid
  end

  it "checks the scheme of an external URL" do
    expect(Database.new(name: "managed", engine: "postgresql", source: "external", url: "redis://example.com")).not_to be_valid
    expect(Database.create!(name: "managed", engine: "postgresql", source: "external", url: "REDACTED").status).to eq("external")
  end

  describe "attachments" do
    let(:database) { Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17", status: "running") }
    let(:manager) { instance_double(DatabaseManager, create_user: "", remove_user: "", apply_firewall: "") }

    before { allow(DatabaseManager).to receive(:new).and_return(manager) }

    it "gives an app on the same server its own database over the kamal network" do
      project = create(:project, name: "shop")
      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL")

      expect(attachment.attach!).to be(true)
      expect(manager).to have_received(:create_user).with(attachment)
      expect(attachment).to have_attributes(database_name: "shop", username: "shop")
      expect(project.environment_for(nil)["DATABASE_URL"]).to eq("postgres://shop:#{attachment.password}@kamal-web-db-main:5432/shop")
      expect(manager).not_to have_received(:apply_firewall)
    end

    it "needs a published port for an app on another server, then connects over TLS" do
      project = create(:project, name: "shop", config_snapshots: { "production" => { "roles" => { "web" => [ "192.0.2.20" ] } } })
      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, destination: "production", variable: "DATABASE_URL")

      expect(attachment.attach!).to be(false)
      expect(attachment.errors[:base].first).to include("port for other servers")

      database.update!(public_port: 25432)
      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, destination: "production", variable: "DATABASE_URL")
      expect(attachment.attach!).to be(true)
      expect(attachment.database_name).to eq("shop_production")
      expect(project.environment_for("production")["DATABASE_URL"]).to end_with("@192.0.2.10:25432/shop_production?sslmode=require")
      expect(database.remote_app_hosts).to eq([ "192.0.2.20" ])
      expect(manager).to have_received(:apply_firewall)
    end

    it "updates the stored URL when the database changes and removes it on detach" do
      project = create(:project, name: "shop", config_snapshots: { "" => { "roles" => { "web" => [ "192.0.2.20" ] } } })
      database.update!(public_port: 25432)
      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL")
      attachment.attach!

      database.update!(public_port: 25433)
      expect(project.environment_for(nil)["DATABASE_URL"]).to include("192.0.2.10:25433")

      attachment.reload.detach!
      expect(manager).to have_received(:remove_user).with(attachment, delete_data: false)
      expect(project.environment_variables.reload).to be_empty
    end

    it "doesn't replace a variable the project already has" do
      project = create(:project)
      project.environment_variables.create!(key: "DATABASE_URL", value: "sqlite3:storage/production.sqlite3")

      attachment = database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL")
      expect(attachment.attach!).to be(false)
      expect(attachment.errors[:variable]).to be_present
    end

    it "tells whether the app's config passes the variable on" do
      project = create(:project, config_snapshots: { "" => { "roles" => { "web" => [ "192.0.2.10" ] }, "raw" => { "env" => { "secret" => [ "RAILS_MASTER_KEY", "DATABASE_URL" ] } } } })
      expect(database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL")).to be_listed_in_config
      expect(database.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "QUEUE_DATABASE_URL")).not_to be_listed_in_config
    end

    it "gives each Redis app its own database number" do
      redis = Database.create!(name: "cache", engine: "redis", source: "created", server: server, image: "valkey/valkey:8", status: "running")
      first, second = create(:project, name: "a"), create(:project, name: "b")

      redis.attachments.new(project: first, variable: "REDIS_URL").attach!
      redis.attachments.new(project: second, variable: "REDIS_URL").attach!

      expect(first.environment_for(nil)["REDIS_URL"]).to eq("redis://:#{redis.password}@kamal-web-db-cache:6379/0")
      expect(second.environment_for(nil)["REDIS_URL"]).to end_with("/1")
      expect(manager).not_to have_received(:create_user)
    end

    it "passes an external URL on as it is" do
      managed = Database.create!(name: "managed", engine: "postgresql", source: "external", url: "REDACTED")
      project = create(:project)

      expect(managed.attachments.new(project: project, variable: "DATABASE_URL").attach!).to be(true)
      expect(project.environment_for(nil)["DATABASE_URL"]).to eq(managed.url)
      expect(manager).not_to have_received(:create_user)
    end
  end
end
EOF

require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe "Databases" do
  let(:server) { Server.find_or_create_by!(host: "192.0.2.10") }
  let(:manager) { instance_double(DatabaseManager, create_user: "", remove_user: "", apply_firewall: "", status: "running", remove: "") }

  before do
    sign_in
    allow(DatabaseManager).to receive(:new).and_return(manager)
  end

  it "creates a database on a server in the background" do
    post databases_path, params: { database: { source: "created", engine: "postgresql", name: "main", server_id: server.id, image: "postgres:17", container_name: "ignored" } }

    database = Database.find_by!(name: "main")
    expect(response).to redirect_to(database_path(database))
    expect(database).to have_attributes(status: "provisioning", container_name: "kamal-web-db-main")
    expect(ProvisionDatabaseJob).to have_been_enqueued.with(database)

    get databases_path
    expect(response.body).to include("main", "PostgreSQL", "starting")
  end

  it "registers an existing container and checks it" do
    post databases_path, params: { database: { source: "existing", engine: "redis", name: "cache", server_id: server.id, container_name: "shop-redis" } }

    expect(Database.find_by!(name: "cache")).to have_attributes(status: "running", container_name: "shop-redis")
  end

  it "attaches an app and detaches it" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17", status: "running")
    project = create(:project, name: "shop")

    get database_path(database)
    expect(response.body).to include("shop")

    post database_attachments_path(database), params: { database_attachment: { target: "#{project.id}/", variable: "" } }
    expect(response).to redirect_to(database_path(database))
    expect(flash[:notice]).to include("DATABASE_URL")
    expect(project.environment_variables.pluck(:key)).to eq([ "DATABASE_URL" ])
    expect(AuditEvent.last.action).to eq("databases/attachments#create")

    get project_settings_path(project)
    expect(response.body).to include(database_path(database), "DATABASE_URL")

    get database_path(database)
    expect(response.body).to include("env.secret")

    delete database_path(database)
    expect(flash[:alert]).to be_present
    expect(Database.exists?(database.id)).to be(true)

    attachment = database.attachments.first
    delete database_attachment_path(database, attachment), params: { delete_data: "1" }
    expect(manager).to have_received(:remove_user).with(attachment, delete_data: true)
    expect(project.environment_variables.reload).to be_empty
  end

  it "shows why an attachment failed" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17", status: "running")
    project = create(:project)
    allow(manager).to receive(:create_user).and_raise(RemoteShell::Error, "192.0.2.10: permission denied")

    post database_attachments_path(database), params: { database_attachment: { target: "#{project.id}/", variable: "DATABASE_URL" } }

    expect(flash[:alert]).to include("permission denied")
    expect(database.attachments).to be_empty
    expect(project.environment_variables).to be_empty
  end

  it "deletes a created database with or without its volume" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17")

    delete database_path(database), params: { delete_data: "1" }

    expect(response).to redirect_to(databases_path)
    expect(manager).to have_received(:remove).with(delete_data: true)
    expect(Database.count).to eq(0)
  end

  it "publishes another port by running the container again" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17", status: "running")

    patch database_path(database), params: { database: { name: "main", public_port: "25432", image: "postgres:18" } }

    expect(database.reload).to have_attributes(public_port: 25432, image: "postgres:17", status: "provisioning")
    expect(ProvisionDatabaseJob).to have_been_enqueued.with(database)
  end
end
EOF

cd /Users/ken/Developer/Personal/kamal_web && cat > spec/requests/databases_spec.rb <<'EOF'
require "rails_helper"

RSpec.describe "Databases" do
  let(:server) { Server.find_or_create_by!(host: "192.0.2.10") }
  let(:manager) { instance_double(DatabaseManager, create_user: "", remove_user: "", apply_firewall: "", status: "running", remove: "") }

  before do
    sign_in
    allow(DatabaseManager).to receive(:new).and_return(manager)
  end

  it "creates a database on a server in the background" do
    post databases_path, params: { database: { source: "created", engine: "postgresql", name: "main", server_id: server.id, image: "postgres:17", container_name: "ignored" } }

    database = Database.find_by!(name: "main")
    expect(response).to redirect_to(database_path(database))
    expect(database).to have_attributes(status: "provisioning", container_name: "kamal-web-db-main")
    expect(ProvisionDatabaseJob).to have_been_enqueued.with(database)

    get databases_path
    expect(response.body).to include("main", "PostgreSQL", "starting")
  end

  it "registers an existing container and checks it" do
    post databases_path, params: { database: { source: "existing", engine: "redis", name: "cache", server_id: server.id, container_name: "shop-redis" } }

    expect(Database.find_by!(name: "cache")).to have_attributes(status: "running", container_name: "shop-redis")
  end

  it "attaches an app and detaches it" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17", status: "running")
    project = create(:project, name: "shop")

    get database_path(database)
    expect(response.body).to include("shop")

    post database_attachments_path(database), params: { database_attachment: { target: "#{project.id}/", variable: "" } }
    expect(response).to redirect_to(database_path(database))
    expect(flash[:notice]).to include("DATABASE_URL")
    expect(project.environment_variables.pluck(:key)).to eq([ "DATABASE_URL" ])
    expect(AuditEvent.last.action).to eq("databases/attachments#create")

    get project_settings_path(project)
    expect(response.body).to include(database_path(database), "DATABASE_URL")

    get database_path(database)
    expect(response.body).to include("env.secret")

    delete database_path(database)
    expect(flash[:alert]).to be_present
    expect(Database.exists?(database.id)).to be(true)

    attachment = database.attachments.first
    delete database_attachment_path(database, attachment), params: { delete_data: "1" }
    expect(manager).to have_received(:remove_user).with(attachment, delete_data: true)
    expect(project.environment_variables.reload).to be_empty
  end

  it "shows why an attachment failed" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17", status: "running")
    project = create(:project)
    allow(manager).to receive(:create_user).and_raise(RemoteShell::Error, "192.0.2.10: permission denied")

    post database_attachments_path(database), params: { database_attachment: { target: "#{project.id}/", variable: "DATABASE_URL" } }

    expect(flash[:alert]).to include("permission denied")
    expect(database.attachments).to be_empty
    expect(project.environment_variables).to be_empty
  end

  it "deletes a created database with or without its volume" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17")

    delete database_path(database), params: { delete_data: "1" }

    expect(response).to redirect_to(databases_path)
    expect(manager).to have_received(:remove).with(delete_data: true)
    expect(Database.count).to eq(0)
  end

  it "publishes another port by running the container again" do
    database = Database.create!(name: "main", engine: "postgresql", source: "created", server: server, image: "postgres:17", status: "running")

    patch database_path(database), params: { database: { name: "main", public_port: "25432", image: "postgres:18" } }

    expect(database.reload).to have_attributes(public_port: 25432, image: "postgres:17", status: "provisioning")
    expect(ProvisionDatabaseJob).to have_been_enqueued.with(database)
  end
end
EOF
